# Feature: Orb pouch — sanity check

<!-- Generated by the project-manager tool from pm.yml. Do not edit by hand; the store is the source of truth. -->

## Goal

Sanity-check candidate mechanic #67 (Orb pouch) from Orbs before it is used in real levels. Effect: Pouch levels count orbs up and let you spend them. Unique: a level rule that counts orbs up as a spendable pouch. Useful: spend orbs on scales and doors instead of only collecting them. Source status in the candidate file is 'revised'; it was revised from human review and is now treated as a trial candidate.

## User Story

**As a** player

**I want** pouch levels count orbs up and let you spend them.

**So that** spend orbs on scales and doors instead of only collecting them.

## High-Level Use Case

The player meets Orb pouch for the first time in its teaching room (mech-67-orb-pouch-room). Teaching moment: First room: a pouch level with an orb-door shortcut priced at one orb before the scale that needs two. A player who spends on the shortcut arrives at the scale one orb short and must go back for orbs they passed, which teaches that a counter that counts up is a budget and that spending is part of the level's order. The sanity check plays that room, exercises every rule below, and records a replayable session.

## Player-Facing Behavior

- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: In a pouch level the counter flips: orbs you collect count up into a held pouch instead of orbs-left counting down
- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: Scales and orb-doors spend from the pouch when you press into them at their stated cost, and unspent orbs are your score at the warp
- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: The gate in a pouch level opens on pouch spent, not orbs collected

## Edge Cases & Rules

- Movement/state stays deterministic: state advances only through the pure step function with recorded t_ms; a recorded session replays to the same end state.
- Restart (R / restart) restores the room to its initial state, including this mechanic.

## UI / Feedback

- The player sees Orb pouch's effect happen on its tile(s) exactly as the rules above describe; no hidden state.
- Any counter, inventory or HUD impact follows the rules above; if a rule needs a counter it is shown while it matters (see Open Questions).
- Failure in the teaching room returns the player to the room start / checkpoint for an immediate retry.

## Assets & Level Data Needed

- Level JSON: new Test Level mech-67-orb-pouch-room (rows + legend) implementing the teaching moment above.
- Sprites/defs: reuse existing tiles where the mechanic reuses an existing tile; add a new sprite/tile def only if this mechanic introduces a new tile (confirm in the implement task).
- Source: plans/level-design/candidate-mechanics/orbs.yml mechanic #67.

## Open Questions

- Human review to honour: I think for certian level instead of having counting down the orbs, you change the critera. So here we flip the orbs counters to count up.
- Human review to honour: this would allow for more mechnaics like spending orbs somehow.
- Synergies deferred to a later run (do not build now): Heavy orb (17): push an orb onto a scale to spend it, the pouch made physical.
- Synergies deferred to a later run (do not build now): Orb bank (94): unspent pouch orbs bank into the next level.
- Confirm any new sprite/tile def and any HUD counter this mechanic needs before the implement task is approved.
